name: Erica Feldmann
reason: Her only website is her HausWitch shop (hauswitchstore.com), and its blog and shop carry partisan political content (a 'Witches Against Fascism' collection with 'Hex all Fascists', 'Banish Billionaires' and 'Free Palestine' items, 'Witch the Vote' posts, and 'How Witches Can Help the Revolution' posts). That falls under the brief's political-commentary rule. The listing would also be built around a shop brand and its brand inbox (hello@hauswitch.com), with only about three items (the Kripalu weekend of 8–10 Jan 2027, and the books Intention Obsession and HausMagick). Her personal Instagram @hauswitchathome has 6,627 followers; the brand account @hauswitch has 110K. Owner to decide if the political rule should apply to a shop.
